description: The IT equipment of one Data Hall: draws the hall's IT load from its branch circuits, and all of it becomes heat in the hall. Operating load comes from the Operating Conditions.

emergency_power_off.description: The hall's IT equipment is powered off (EPO) until reset.

name: IT load

design_power.description: Design IT load (site data: plant-design.json basis.it; DH08 is 1,200 kW).

liquid_fraction.description: Share removed by liquid cooling (site data: plant-design.json basis.it; DH08 is 0.4).

power_factor.description: Power factor of the IT power supplies.

ride_through.description: Time the power supplies ride through a total loss of supply.

power_in.description: Branch circuits from the hall's UPS outputs (dual-corded).
